title: Be a Human Being
coreMove: Being human is not a break from serious work; it is the ground serious work stands on: body limits, recovery, solitude, and relationships kept in view.

exampleSpecs.audience: people who treat body limits as defects
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn effort from self-proof into care for the work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Calla hears the body limit in the hoarse voice before another call block

exampleSpecs.audience: people confused by a break inside serious work
exampleSpecs.stakes: make relationships and solitude visible in the training map
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Bram redraws the care map with one connection check and one self-check

exampleSpecs.audience: people who ignore the body until errors prove the cost
exampleSpecs.stakes: show recovery changing the same process
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Bea adds recovery to the rehearsal checklist and mistakes fall

exampleSpecs.audience: people auditing where humanity dropped out of a process
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep relationships visible before isolation hardens
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: June marks the missing meal-and-ride line instead of blaming the script

exampleSpecs.audience: people tempted to keep body warnings private
exampleSpecs.stakes: hear the body before overwork becomes public
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ellis writes the dizzy note before another duty

exampleSpecs.audience: people planning scarce attention across relationships and solitude
exampleSpecs.stakes: build humanity into the plan before pressure erases it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Rana gives damp-cot checks, family updates, and quiet review each a place
